pages.name: French Defense: Advance Variation, Milner-Barry Gambit, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 2 had an ambiguous ...Ne7-f5 route (both knights can reach e7); plan 3 targeted a backward c-pawn Black no longer has. Rewrote plans 2 and 3.

pages.name: French Defense: Advance Variation, Paulsen Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an f2-f4-f5 route behind the f3-knight. Rewrote plan 1. Plan 2 (light-squared bishop via ...b6 and ...Ba6 next to ...Qb6) was rewritten twice and rejected twice (the second time because ...Bb5 is blocked by the c6-knight); old text kept with British spelling and its references added to the skips.

pages.name: French Defense: Advance Variation, Steinitz Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Be2 or d3 with no white d-pawn; plan 2 recaptured on c5 with ...Nc6-a5. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: French: Advance, 3...b6
pages.notes: The overview and plans said 3...b6 fianchettoes the bishop to b7, where the d5-pawn blocks it; the real idea is ...Ba6 to exchange light-squared bishops (reviewer). Rewrote the overview and plans 1-3.

pages.name: French: Advance, 3...b6
pages.notes: The overview and plan 1 had the bishop fianchettoed to b7, where the d5-pawn blocks it; 4...Qd7 prepares ...Ba6 (reviewer). Plan 2 had an f4-f5 route. Rewrote the overview and both plans.

pages.name: French: Advance, 3...Ne7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had an Ne2-g3 route and Be2/d3; plan 1 had an Ne7-f5 route. Reworded both.

pages.name: French: Advance, 5.Nf3 Qb6 6.a3 Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted an f8-knight that does not exist. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: French: Advance, 5.Nf3 Qb6 6.a3 c4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had f4-f5 behind the f3-knight and a d2-b3 route; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote both.

pages.name: French: Advance, 5.Nf3 Qb6 6.a3 c4 7.Nbd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an f2-f4-f5 route; plan 3 rerouted the d2-knight via b1; plan 4 called both light-squared bishops bad (White's bad bishop is the dark-squared one, reviewer). Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4.

pages.name: French: Advance, 5.Nf3 Qb6 6.Be2 cxd4 7.cxd4
pages.notes: The overview had ...Nh6-f7 with Black's pawn on f7; plan 3 had an Ne1-g2 route; plan 4 had ...Ba6 with the queen on b6 and called the open c-file half-open. Rewrote the overview and plans 3 and 4.
